blurb:
I've worked in financial services and mortgage tech for years, shipping systems that have to stay correct under load. That usually means Kotlin and Spring Boot on the backend, React and Next.js on the front, and lately more AI-assisted flows where they actually save time.

Happy to talk if you're hiring, want to collaborate, or are curious about something below.
